description: Modular .NET libraries for functional C#: Result, Maybe, Any, Rules, Mediator, Validation, Entity, EF Core, Endpoints, Dependency Injection, Resilience and more.
rules: Each CSharpEssentials.* package ships separately on NuGet; install only the packages the code uses.

Return Result or Result<T> from operations that can fail and build failures with the Error factories (Error.Validation, Error.NotFound, Error.Conflict, Error.Domain, Error.Failure) instead of throwing.
Every Result and Maybe member that returns Task or ValueTask ends in Async; use BindAsync, not Bind, for async lambdas.
default(Result) and default(Result<T>) are failures since 9.0; return Result.Success() or a value for success.
Error.Exception(ex) gives ErrorType.Unexpected since 9.0; ErrorType.Domain maps to HTTP 422.
The skills under .well-known/agent-skills/ hold runnable examples and exact API names per package.
